titulo: Ukraine’s petrol stations are the latest target for Putin’s drones: ‘When I see something... I run for my life’
cuerpo: With Ukraine’s petrol stations a key target for Russian drones, customers are advised to spend no more than 10 minutes filling up. Those working on these deadly forecourts tell Harry Stourton in Pavlohrad, eastern Ukraine, how they take their lives in their hands every day they go to work
